post_stop_bank_size_sensitivity_current_.method: replay frozen MPNet task-instruction embedding coverage only; no agent action, environment reset, evaluator call, or treatment outcome

root_cause_adjudication.why_not_mechanism_failure: No validation treatment was opened. The experiment stopped before A/B or C/D execution, and the full source pool contains strong semantic support for the missing units.
root_cause_adjudication.why_32_of_32_was_required: The preregistered A/B estimand requires the same frozen actionable memory retrieval to exist for every planned primary cluster. With zero retrieval on task 279, A and B have no defined provenance-bearing treatment surface for that independent unit. Dropping or replacing it after support inspection would change the frozen sample.

recommended_future_changes: Replace skill-union support proxy with the exact native retrieval-support calculation before source execution authority opens.
Use a larger source bank or a prospectively coverage-aware source selection rule based only on pre-outcome task/embedding structure.
Keep outcome-blindness, but require a pre-execution semantic coverage margin rather than mere command-union coverage.

For a fresh experiment, choose source-bank size prospectively from an independent calibration/support surface; the post-stop observation that 224 or 256 covers the current 40 units is diagnostic and cannot itself justify the exact future size.

Consider defining the future estimand on a prospectively qualified support set with a minimum independent-n rule, instead of coupling a random source subsample to an all-or-nothing 32/32 gate, if that estimand is declared before any target outcome.
